summary: Inside an elevator, Trinity and Neo begin preparing an explosive device: Trinity immediately drops and opens the suitcase to wire a bomb while Neo disables the car and searches for a way out of the shaft. The scene shows them transitioning from riding the elevator to actively rigging explosives and locating an escape route through the false ceiling.

what_changes.before: Standing and riding in the elevator
what_changes.after: Drops down and begins wiring an explosive device
what_changes.evidence: Trinity immediately drops and opens the suitcase, wiring a plastique and napalm bomb.

what_changes.after: Stops the elevator and accesses the shaft
what_changes.evidence: Neo hits the emergency stop.  He pulls down part of the false ceiling and finds the elevator shaft access panel.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity and Neo rig a bomb and find an escape route while ascending the government building's elevators.

uncertain: Whether they succeed in escaping through the shaft
The target or purpose of the bomb beyond its preparation
